title: Electrified Bamboo
body:
Description

[Editor's Note: To update: Spawn locations, hardness. Trivia would be nice as well :)]

Electrified Bamboo is a variation of Bamboo that is created when Bamboo is struck by lightning, either naturally or through the use of a Copper Axe.

It can be identified by its bright-red colour and red electricity particles. To refine this material, one must use a Metal Sander and/or Steel Planker.

Locations

Electrified Bamboo can be found anywhere normal Bamboo spawns; it is created when Bamboo or Oobmab is struck by lightning or through the use of a Copper Axe. As of version 1.67.0, it has a chance to spawn at Electrified Meteor crash sites.

Trivia

[Editor's Note: Please use any more info to update the page thanks. :)]

  • It is currently the only tree to use the Neon texture in its planked form (aside from admin trees).
  • Its 1 of 3 trees that have a particle effect the others being eel kelp and electrified tree.
